subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Knights of Favonius Headquarters

706900201.text: Finally... We made it to the last stack.

706900202.text: What even are some of these books... "A Hilichurl's Guide to Running for Your Life"? Do Hilichurls even read? Oh, and "Basics of Whopperflower Cultivation"... Who'd grow one of those anyway!?

706900203.text: And, what's this one... "The Little Witch's Dictionary"? Huh, that title's kinda suspicious. And, didn't we already sort this area? Did you notice it earlier?

706900205.text: Huh, well "witches" always make Paimon think of... Y'know...

706900208.text: Alice? How did you get in here?

706900209.text: Hm? You must not have noticed, Paimon. I wasn't the one who barged in at all. When you opened that dictionary, you entered a mage's domain.

706900210.text: What!? Ugh, Paimon knew that book had issues!

706900211.text: Hm, have you ever read the storybook, "The Little Witch and the Undying Fire," by any chance?

706900101.text: Whoa, this is way too many books!

706900102.text: Considering this library-organizing job was classified as a premium commission, Paimon came mentally prepared, y'know?

706900103.text: But, seeing it in person is something else...

706900104.text: Why, if it isn't cutie and Paimon! What brings you back to Mondstadt?

706900105.text: Let me guess... You missed me so much, you just had to come visit, is that it?

706900107.text: Hehe, you've become quite the flatterer since we last saw each other, haven't you?

706900109.text: Hehe, found you! We were starting to think you weren't clocking in today.

706900110.text: Hehe, well, I wasn't planning to. But then, Katheryne mentioned someone had finally accepted an important commission for the library, so I came to check on things.

706900111.text: Might you... both be here for that very commission, by any chance?
